name: Nojima Tomoko
source:
In the same year as Tatsuhiko, Misaki's best friend. A late bloomer, who is a bookworm.

Not very good at speaking with boys, but can do it safely when with Misaki.

While studying in a different seminar, frequently makes her appearance in Tatsuhiko's seminar.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145]Getchu[/url]]
